infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Wakeel needs access to your microphone for voice messages.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Wakeel uses your location to give you contextual help like weather, nearby places, and travel times.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Wakeel uses your location in the background to provide proactive reminders and contextual assistance.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Wakeel can read and create calendar events to help manage your schedule.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Wakeel can read and create reminders to help you stay on track.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Wakeel needs full calendar access to read and create events on your behalf.
infoPlist.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Wakeel needs full reminders access to read and create reminders on your behalf.

plugins.photosPermission: Wakeel needs access to your photos to share them in chat.
plugins.cameraPermission: Wakeel needs access to your camera to take photos.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your microphone for voice messages.
